# Map-6 — Interactive GTA 6 Map

> Free interactive map for Grand Theft Auto VI — Vice City, the Keys, and beyond.

## Primary URLs

- Homepage: https://map-6.com/
- Interactive map: https://map-6.com/map
- All locations: https://map-6.com/locations
- Collectibles: https://map-6.com/collectibles
- Guides: https://map-6.com/guides
- Sitemap: https://map-6.com/sitemap.xml

## What Map-6 provides

- 1400+ community POIs on an interactive map
- Category filters: landmarks, collectibles, shops, missions, secrets
- Game coordinate readout and distance measurement
- SEO pages per location for search and AI citation

## Map data attribution

Map tiles © GTADB / GTA VI Mapping Community — CC BY 4.0 (https://gtadb.org)

## Contact / updates

Site: Map-6 (map-6.com). Built for GTA VI launch community.
